terms.gloss: for play; a toy version of something
terms.comment: Our productive toy descriptions use lūsōrius (tractrum lūsōrium, grūs lūsōria, autoraeda lūsōria); each full compound is labelled as composed unless independently recorded.

sources: Lewis & Short: lusorius
Descriptions and prompts labelled as ours are composed for family conversation. Recorded vocabulary does not imply universal technical standardization.
